Meridian Health Plan
Utilization Management Department
1400 Concourse Parkway, Suite 300, Phoenix, AZ 85034
Date: 2026-07-02
Marcus T. Reeves
PT-559201
Member ID: MHP-77410-A
RE: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
Reference #: PA-2026-661204
Claim #: HC-CLM-77410
Service: CPT 29881 — Knee Arthroscopy w/ Meniscectomy
Requested Date: 2026-07-15
Determination: DENIED
Denial Reason Code: MN-07 — Medical necessity not established
Explanation
Dear Mr. Reeves,
After review by our Medical Director, the requested procedure (CPT 29881) has been denied. Our clinical review
determined that the submitted documentation does not demonstrate that a minimum of 6 weeks of conservative
treatment was fully exhausted and documented per Meridian Health Plan's Musculoskeletal Surgery Guideline
MSK-014. Specifically, physical therapy visit notes and a formal re-evaluation following the conservative treatment
course were not included with this request.
Appeal Rights
You or your provider have the right to request a formal appeal of this decision within 180 days of this notice. Appeals
should be submitted in writing to the address above, Attn: Appeals & Grievances, and should include any additional
supporting clinical documentation, including physical therapy records and a physician re-evaluation note.
Sincerely,
Dr. Rachel Okafor, MD
Medical Director, Meridian Health Plan

Denise K. Alvarado
PT-99201
Member ID: AHN-88201-C
RE: Notice of Claim Denial
Claim #: CLM-88201
Service: CPT 93458 — Left Heart Catheterization
Date of Service: 2026-07-09
Amount Billed: $14,500.00
Determination: DENIED
Denial Reason Code: CO-197 — Precertification/Authorization Absent
Explanation
Dear Ms. Alvarado,
Claim CLM-88201 has been denied because our records show no prior authorization was obtained for CPT 93458 prior
to the date of service. Arizona Health Network's plan requires precertification for all cardiac catheterization procedures
performed in an outpatient hospital setting. As no prior authorization token is on file for this claim, payment cannot be
issued.
Appeal Rights
The provider may submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical documentation demonstrating medical
urgency, or file a formal appeal within 90 days of this notice. Appeals should be sent in writing to the address above,
Attn: Appeals Department.
Sincerely,
Dr. Priya Nandakumar, MD
Medical Director, Arizona Health Network
